content:
The Amazon Black Friday sale has officially kicked off and the retailer is already dropping some winning LEGO discounts we don’t expect to go any lower.

I’m a big fan of the LEGO Botanical collection, with sets that offer some solid building complexity and a great decoration once you’re finished. The Dried Flower Centerpiece was actually retired by LEGO earlier this year, but remains one of the most ‘fall-coded’ Botanical sets, perfect for Thanksgiving.

Amazon's latest Black Friday deal knocks $15 off the list price of $49.99, bringing the set down to its lowest price of the year.

LEGO Dried Flower Centerpiece Drops to Lowest Price of the Year

As mentioned, the LEGO Dried Flower Centerpiece set is officially retired, meaning LEGO has ceased production. Once it goes out of stock at major retailers, it’s most likely gone forever. The plus side of these retired sets is they typically get the best discounts, as retailers with leftover stock try to make room for new releases.

The LEGO Dried Flower Centerpiece comes with 812 pieces. With Amazon’s discount, you’re paying less than four cents per piece. For reference, LEGO sticks to a relatively standard 10 cent per prick pricing model, making this an absolute steal.

The set itself is an intricate depiction of, well, a flower centerpiece. You build soft orange roses and deep red gerbera layered in leaves and smaller flower details. The full set is a gorgeous collection of autumn colors and different textures, though as an 18+ build, you’ll have to keep track of some particularly small bricks.

A big benefit of this set compared to the many bouquets in the Botanical Collection is you don’t have to worry about a vase or stand – the centerpiece is ready to display as soon as you finish building.

More LEGO Sets on Sale for Black Friday

Only one other LEGO Botanical set is getting a proper Black Friday discount, and that’s the Mini Bonsai Trees
set that was released earlier this year. However, Amazon has quite a few more LEGO flower deals outside of its major sales.

We’re keeping track of all of the best Black Friday LEGO deals, which includes the launch of a new set, LEGO Godzilla. For more, check out Amazon’s full sale schedule.
